LESSON: CREATING

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: CREATING
Topic 4.1: Creating

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Creating. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is your favourite shape?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the use of ICT in creating shapes and forms electronic devices independently while observing personal safety. experience Core-Competence to be developed Self efficacy: 95

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate the use of ICT in creating shapes and forms electronic devices independently while observing personal safety. experience Core-Competence to be developed Self efficacy: 95
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the use of ICT in creating shapes and forms electronic devices independently while observing personal safety. experience Core-Competence to be developed Self efficacy: 95. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Creating.
2. Explain Creating to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Guide learners to create like using c) appreciate the use of ICT in shapes and forms using creating shapes and forms digital devices
4. Show that you can: appreciate the use of ICT in creating shapes and forms electronic devices independently while observing personal safety. experience Core-Competence to be developed Self efficacy: 95
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Creating. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What is your favourite shape?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Guide learners to create like using c) appreciate the use of ICT in shapes and forms using creating shapes and forms digital devices
2. Guide learners to use electronic devices independently while observing personal safety.
3. Guide learners to share experience Core-Competence to be developed Self efficacy:
4. Draw shapes and forms but with assistance to identify and
5. Draw shapes and forms assistance use tools to draw shapes the electronic gadgets with

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate the use of ICT in creating shapes and forms electronic devices independently while observing personal safety. experience Core-Competence to be developed Self efficacy: 95
